message: Vector Rebel 3.2.71: show actual past inspection checks for swing firefighters and leave other-shift/unassigned past tours blank instead of incorrectly marking OFF or missed.
releaseNotes: Daily Captain Check results now display any verified native completed PPE inspection for a swing firefighter on a past C-shift tour as a green check, even though that swing did not belong to the permanent Captain Set. A swing from another shift whose past C-shift tour has no verified check is left blank, not OFF or a red missed check. No earlier PPE obligation is invented merely because the person is on the current temporary roster; the only required swing dates are the specifically selected Day 1 / Day 2 for the current audit, or a separately documented attendance exception. Previously entered manual entire-tour absences remain gray OFF*. Added a captain-entered historical attendance reason Different shift / other captain for permanent Captain Set members whose earlier tour was under another crew; this produces a blank (unless their official native check history proves a green completion). Existing check histories are neither erased nor fabricated; Read-only Item Log audits, Recheck Missing, prior SCBA safety protections, portable backup and CrewSense read-only operation remain unchanged.
